title: Night Out Scorecard
description: Hosted social evening with an activity illustration and a playful scorecard
useWhen: Archy hosts an evening built around an activity (bowling by default) and a lighter, illustrated feel is wanted.
notWhen: there is a good venue photo and the place should lead (use `Night Out Photo Fade`).
guidance: Dates follow the house style: "March 12 – 14, 2026". Kickers and event names in title case (the design sets uppercase where needed).
Leave out any fact that does not exist (venue, time): its label goes with it and the layout closes up.
headline: the invitation line, one white block ("Pull up a chair, Inland Empire."), about two lines. The event page cover splits it into two lines by itself.
card-player and card-total: the scorecard's player name and total ("Inland Empire Dentists", "On us"). The card is optional; leave both out to drop it.
image-illustration: the activity illustration (transparent PNG). The bowling pins are the default; another activity needs an illustration from the design team.
The event page cover shows a photo of the venue in its circle and as its ground: ask for it only when the cover is made.
